nodes.name: Ancient Gateway
aliases: Ancient Gateway and the Fortress Gateways
nodes.summary: Precursor gateway site the Exile reaches in Legacy of the Precursors after the Precursor Fortress rises; the Exile uses its levers and a Precursor Beacon there to open the route to the Burning Monolith.

sources.locator: quest log: 'Travel to the Ancient Gateway', 'Explore the Ancient Gateway', 'Find and use Levers', 'Activate the Precursor Beacon'

nodes.name: Western and Eastern Enigma Chambers
nodes.summary: Two endgame chambers entered through the Western and Eastern Gateways; each holds a boss fight (Count Geonor in the west, Doryani in the east) and a Crisis Fragment (Ancient and Weathered) needed to open the Burning Monolith.

sources.locator: quest log (hidden comment block): 'Travel to the Western Enigma Chamber', 'Defeat Count Geonor', 'Defeat Doryani', 'Pick up the Ancient Crisis Fragment'
Keys: 'The other two keys can be found in the Western Enigma Chamber and the Eastern Enigma Chamber.'

nodes.name: The Patriarch and Matriarch Halls
nodes.summary: Two Precursor halls visited in Legacy of the Precursors; the Exile defeats Phyx, Sentinel of the Spark, and Phya, Sentinel of the Cradle, to recover the Origin Spark and Origin Cradle.

sources.locator: quest log (hidden comment block) steps 112-128: 'Travel to the Patriarch Halls', 'Defeat Phyx, Sentinel of the Spark', 'Defeat Phya, Sentinel of the Cradle'

edges.description: The quest's Doryani briefing takes place at the Ziggurat, where he explains his Waygate plan.

sources.locator: 'Take a Waystone from Doryani': 'Take a Waystone reward from Doryani in The Ziggurat Refuge.'

edges.description: Doryani is the quest giver, proposing to recover Precursor knowledge through the Waygate.

sources.locator: 'Speak to Doryani': 'I have already been working on a plan... The machine you see here... I call it... a Waygate.'

edges.description: Doryani presents the Waygate built over the leylines beneath the Ziggurat.

sources.locator: 'Speak to Doryani: leylines, Waygate': 'This Ziggurat was built over what my ancestors called leylines.'

edges.description: Doryani introduces the Waygate built over the leylines and gives the Exile the Waystone.

sources.locator: 'Speak to Doryani: leylines, Waygate': Doryani introduces the Waygate and gives the Waystone.

edges.description: The Exile takes the Waystone from Doryani at the Ziggurat Refuge and enters the first Map through the Waygate.

sources.locator: 'Take a Waystone from Doryani' / 'Select and enter a Map': 'Take a Waystone reward from Doryani in The Ziggurat Refuge.'

edges.description: Doryani sends the Exile through the untested Waygate and then declares it a success ('Science is a process').

sources.locator: 'Speak to Doryani': 'Our first step is a success! The Waygate does indeed work.' / 'Science is a process.'

edges.description: The Exile travels to a Precursor Tower and activates its beacon.

sources.locator: 'Travel to the Precursor Tower': 'Travel to the Precursor Tower.'

edges.description: Doryani identifies the tower as Precursor and orders the beacon activated ('I'm making... a judgement call. Do it.').

sources.locator: 'Speak to Doryani' (Travel to the Precursor Tower): 'This tower is indeed Precursor. We should activate it'

edges.description: The Exile explores the Ancient Gateway, uses its levers and activates a Precursor Beacon there.

sources.locator: 'Travel to the Ancient Gateway', 'Explore the Ancient Gateway', 'Activate the Precursor Beacon'

edges.description: Doryani is summoned at the Ancient Gateway's central platform and speaks with the Exile there.

sources.locator: 'Reach the central platform', 'Summon Doryani', 'Speak to Doryani' (quest log steps after 'Explore the Ancient Gateway')

edges.description: The Exile reaches and explores the Burning Monolith, the endgame site where the Arbiter of Ash waits.

sources.locator: 'Reach the Burning Monolith', 'Explore the Burning Monolith'
Lead: 'The Burning Monolith is a special area in the Precursor Fortress.'

edges.description: The Burning Monolith is a special area inside the Precursor Fortress in the 0.5 layout.

sources.locator: Lead: 'The Burning Monolith is a special area in the Precursor Fortress.'; Version history 0.5.0: 'moved into the Fortress'

edges.description: Doryani is spoken to during the Burning Monolith sequence of the quest ('Speak to Doryani' after 'Explore the Burning Monolith').

sources.locator: 'Explore the Burning Monolith' / 'Speak to Doryani' (quest log after 'Reach the Burning Monolith')

edges.description: The Exile fights in the Western and Eastern Enigma Chambers behind the Gateways.

sources.locator: 'Travel to the Western Enigma Chamber', 'Explore the Eastern Enigma Chamber'

edges.description: Count Geonor is defeated in the Western Enigma Chamber, which yields the Ancient Crisis Fragment.

sources.locator: 'Defeat Count Geonor' (Western Enigma Chamber) / 'Pick up the Ancient Crisis Fragment'

edges.description: Doryani, Royal Thaumaturge, is fought in the Eastern Enigma Chamber, which yields the Weathered Crisis Fragment.

sources.locator: 'Defeat Doryani' (Eastern Enigma Chamber) / 'Pick up the Weathered Crisis Fragment'
Keys table: 'Doryani, Royal Thaumaturge | Weathered Crisis Fragment'

edges.description: The Arbiter of Ash is the pinnacle boss of the Burning Monolith and is defeated in quest step 101.

sources.locator: MonsterBox location: 'The Burning Monolith'; lead: 'the pinnacle boss of The Burning Monolith'
step 101 'Defeat the Arbiter of Ash'

edges.description: After the Arbiter falls, Tecrod's mysterious entity riding a wyrm steals the Flame Seed.

sources.locator: Lore: 'A Mysterious Entity riding a wyrm that steals the Flame Seed after the Arbiter of Ash is defeated... This figure is revealed to be Tecrod'
Lore: 'The Mysterious Entity that steals the Flame Seed after the Arbiter of Ash is defeated is Tecrod.'

edges.description: The Exile explores the Patriarch and Matriarch Halls to take the Origin Spark and Origin Cradle.

sources.locator: steps 112-128: 'Travel to the Patriarch Halls', 'Explore Matriarch Halls', 'Pick up the Origin Cradle'

edges.description: Phyx, Sentinel of the Spark, is defeated in the Patriarch Halls to recover the Origin Spark.

sources.locator: steps 114 and 126: 'Defeat Phyx, Sentinel of the Spark' / 'Pick up the Origin Spark'

edges.description: Phya, Sentinel of the Cradle, is defeated in the Matriarch Halls to recover the Origin Cradle.

sources.locator: steps 120-122: 'Defeat Phya, Sentinel of the Cradle' / 'Pick up the Origin Cradle'

edges.description: The Origin Core is made in the Precursor Reactor inside the Origin Tower, and the Exile places it at the tower's top.

sources.locator: Layout: 'a room called the Precursor Reactor'; 'The Origin Core can be placed at the center to fight The Arbiter of Divinity.'
'Travel to the Origin Tower', 'Place the Origin Spark in the Precursor Reactor', 'Ascend the Tower'

edges.description: Tecrod's wyrm incapacitates the Exile when the Origin Core is placed, and Tecrod exults that the Master shall know unending power.

sources.locator: Lore: 'when the player character places the Origin Core into the Origin Tower, Tecrod's wyrm incapacitates the character'

edges.description: Doryani directs the Origin Core ritual at the Origin Tower (steps 131-134).

sources.locator: steps 131-134: 'Speak to Doryani', 'Return to Doryani at the Origin Tower', 'Place the Origin Spark in the Precursor Reactor'

edges.description: The Arbiter of Divinity destroys Tecrod's body and is then fought by the Exile in the Origin Tower.

sources.locator: MonsterBox location: 'The Origin Tower'; lead: 'the pinnacle boss of The Origin Tower'
step 141 'Defeat the Arbiter of Divinity'

edges.description: Tecrod is destroyed by the Arbiter of Divinity, which declares 'Your kind shall never ordain the First Edict!'

sources.locator: Lore: 'his body is destroyed by the Arbiter of Divinity: Your kind shall never ordain the First Edict!'
Lore: 'The Mysterious Entity that is destroyed by the Arbiter of Divinity is Tecrod.'
